requirements: R1: Resolve HTTP 401 errors on employee dossier endpoints to fix specification and coverage audit gaps.
R2: Block PR #1204 for modifying PrivacyService.java (DoD violation) and correct the false critique regarding testStrainManagementCrudEndToEnd.
R3: Implement falsifiability checks to refute agent claims before accepting them in audits and reviews.

slices.title: Patch Dossier Endpoints and Review Verdict Logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the 401 errors and correct the automated review verdicts, so that the self-falsification cycle is closed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the employee dossier endpoints, When accessed by an authorized user, Then no 401 errors are returned.
Given PR #1204 which modifies product code, When the automated review verdict is generated, Then it blocks the PR for a DoD violation.
Given the audit and review agents, When they make claims about the codebase, Then a falsifiability check is executed to verify the claims before acceptance.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: zero false positive or false negative audit findings

slices.title: Verify Dossier Endpoints and Review Verdict Fixes
slices.jtbd: When implementing the QA verification for this epic, I want to test the dossier endpoints and the review verdict logic, so that we ensure the self-falsification findings are actually resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the test environment, When running integration tests against the dossier endpoints, Then they return 200 OK for authorized requests.
Given a mock PR that violates the DoD like PR #1204, When the automated review is executed, Then it is correctly blocked with accurate critiques.
Given the agent logic, When falsifiability checks are tested, Then they correctly refute false claims.
